summary: Alvotech filed a Form 6-K on August 21, 2026, furnishing a press release announcing a strategic licensing and commercialization agreement with Lotus Pharmaceutical for proposed biosimilars AVT34 (durvalumab) and AVT87 (emicizumab) in the U.S. and selected Asian markets. The agreement is semi-exclusive in the U.S., with Alvotech retaining rights to commercialize directly alongside Lotus via Alvogen, while Lotus gets exclusive rights in eight Asian markets. Alvotech handles development, regulatory approvals, and supply. This is a commercial collaboration, not a special-situation corporate event.
